_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Raptor's own egg.
name: Minecraft: Pumpkin
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Pumpkin, a fast Minecraft Java server written in Rust, for the newest Minecraft version. Still in heavy development, so many game features are missing. Checked against the release's checksums.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Pumpkin. Downloads the chosen Pumpkin release for this CPU
# from Pumpkin's GitHub releases and checks it against the release's
# published SHA-256. Worlds, plugins and settings are never touched, and
# the program is only replaced once the new one checks out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

repo=https://github.com/Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin
ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) asset=pumpkin-X64-Linux ;;
    aarch64) asset=pumpkin-ARM64-Linux ;;
    *) fail "Pumpkin has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

version="${PUMPKIN_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ -z "$version" ] || [ "$version" = latest ]; then
    # The newest release (not a nightly), from where GitHub's latest link points.
    version=$(curl -fsSI --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' "$repo/releases/latest") ||
        fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    version=${version##*/tag/}
    version=$(printf '%b' "${version//%/\\x}")
    [ -n "$version" ] && [ "${version#http}" = "$version" ] || fail "Pumpkin has no release to install right now. Reinstall to try again later."
fi
tag=$(jq -rn --arg v "$version" '$v | @uri')
sums=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$repo/releases/download/$tag/checksums.sha256" 2>/dev/null) ||
    fail "Pumpkin has no release $version (or GitHub can't be reached). Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 0.2.2+26.3-26.60."
sum=$(awk -v a="$asset" '$2 == a || $2 == "*" a { print $1 }' <<<"$sums")
[ -n "$sum" ] || fail "Pumpkin $version has no build for this CPU. Choose a newer release."

if [ -f pumpkin ] && [ "$(sha256sum pumpkin | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "Pumpkin $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Pumpkin $version"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o pumpkin.new "$repo/releases/download/$tag/$asset"
    [ "$(sha256sum pumpkin.new | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || { rm -f pumpkin.new; fail "The download didn't match the release's checksum. Reinstall to try again."; }
    chmod +x pumpkin.new
    mv -f pumpkin.new pumpkin
fi
echo "Installed Pumpkin $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Pumpkin release, such as 0.2.2+26.3-26.60, or latest for the newest. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Telemetry
variables.description: Send Pumpkin's developers anonymous heartbeats about the server, every five minutes.
